brief:
Script-In-Hand Theatre presented dramatic readings from a book by We Are Not Numbers, introducing hundreds of British audience members to the work of young Palestinian writers. The UK-based theatre company performed selections from the collection across multiple venues, bringing the narratives of Palestinian youth to theatregoers in Britain.

The readings made the writers' accounts accessible to audiences unfamiliar with their perspectives. By staging the material in dramatic form, Script-In-Hand Theatre created a new avenue for British audiences to encounter the voices and experiences documented in the We Are Not Numbers collection.
dek: Script-In-Hand Theatre introduces hundreds of Britons to the stories of young Palestinian writers.
title: British theatre company stages Palestinian youth stories in dramatic readings
